messages:
matt: Heads-up: preparing internal announce for v2.15.0 tomorrow. Canary at 09:30 UTC, quiet window 09:15-11:00 UTC. Draft: https://docs.redwood/releases/v2.15.0-draft. Please flag anything customer-facing.

deploybot: /deploy canary v2.15.0 --targets=canary-8 --timeout=20m
deploybot: Canary started: v2.15.0 -> canary-8 (8 hosts). Monitoring p95, p99, 5xx.

nina: FYI: we changed cache serialization format for faster startup; add compatibility note: older clients are unaffected, server-side only.

matt: Added compatibility note under "Deployment details".

raj: Ops note: Dedicated fleets remain pinned to runtime@2026-02-10. Add timeline: "unpin after 1 week of GA unless requested."

ema: Legal asked for the privacy line to mention "no customer data persisted beyond retention policy". I'll paste exact wording.

ops-oncall: Thresholds for this canary: auto-rollback on 5xx >= 0.12% for 5m OR p99 +35% for 10m. Manual rollback requires release owner + oncall. I'll be monitoring 09:00-11:30 UTC. Pager: PD_Rollout.

deploybot: Canary health update: 12m in  p95 +3%, p99 +9%, 5xx 0.01%. No rollback.

nina: Add a short FAQ for support: "Why runtime pinned?" and one-liner response.

matt: Done. Final internal announce copy: "Internal: v2.15.0 staged rollout. Canary healthy; promoting to staged rollout. Quiet window 09:15-11:00 UTC. Key notes: runtime pinned for Dedicated; cache serialization change (server-side only); privacy blurb updated. Rollback criteria and runbook: https://confluence.company/ops/runbooks/rollout. Oncall: ops-oncall (PD_Rollout). Public announce planned 11:15 UTC"

raj: LGTM.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged, watching.

matt: Posting internal announce now and will promote in 15m if no issues. Thanks all.

deploybot: /announce internal "v2.15.0 staged rollout  canary healthy, promoting" --channel=#eng-releases --when=6845679150

matt: closing thread after promote."
